items.titleZh: 小红牛续约领队佩尔曼，劳森未来仍不明朗
items.summaryZh: 小红牛与车队领队艾伦·佩尔曼续约至2031年，但车手利亚姆·劳森的合同将在年底到期，其未来仍不明朗。
items.originalTitle: What's going on with Lawson's 'blurry' F1 future
items.summaryEn: Racing Bulls has extended team boss Alan Permane's contract until 2031, but driver Liam Lawson's future remains unclear with his deal expiring at the end of the year.
detailZh: 小红牛已与车队领队续约至2031年，但这份新合同属于车队领队艾伦·佩尔曼，而非利亚姆·劳森，后者的未来充其量仍“模糊不清”。
佩尔曼是小红牛的“联合首席执行官”，除领队职责外还负责竞技事务。他于2024年加入该队，此前在恩斯通车队（先后以贝纳通、雷诺及其众多身份参赛）度过了34年职业生涯，并日益成为其中的关键人物。
佩尔曼获得新合同是应得的。他主导的进步足以让这支红牛第二车队有望以车队积分榜第五名创下队史F1最佳成绩。但劳森在这一成绩中也发挥了关键作用，而他的合同将在年底到期。
尽管车队管理层的合同状况不必让位于车手未来，但在F1世界等待劳森情况明朗、并对此愈发困惑之际宣布领队新合同，时机颇为微妙。
“说实话，目前情况还相当模糊，”劳森本周四在巴西被问及车队何时会告知他未来去向时说道。
“目前没有太多迹象。”
小红牛——考虑到在车手事务上它代表红牛发号施令，这也意味着红牛——尚未确认劳森、新秀队友阿尔维德·林德布拉德以及F2冠军争夺者尼古拉·措洛夫中，谁将在明年参加F1。
很长一段时间以来，措洛夫一直被视为下一顺位人选。早在九月，佩尔曼就曾表示决定将在“未来几周内”做出，并希望“再多花一点时间，确保我们为明年找到正确的搭档”。
劳森以83分在车手积分榜上排名第九。减去他和林德布拉德在赛季中期劳森效力红牛的三场比赛期间所获得的积分，他在积分榜上以69比32领先这位令人印象深刻的新秀。林德布拉德今年的单圈速度尤其强劲，但劳森很好地运用了自己的经验，全面提升了表现，整体上成为了明确的团队领袖。
不幸的是，仅凭这一点还不够。正如珀曼所说：“首要的是速度和节奏以及与之相关的一切。但当然，背景中还有很多因素，因为我想我们处于一个略微独特的情况。”
“我们想培养年轻车手，我们想培养年轻人才，当然我们也关注他们未来的进步。”
“所以，这不仅仅是关于当下，也关乎他们未来能做什么。”
劳森的“当下”表现非常出色。但很明显，他在红牛体系内还没有展现出足够的东西，不足以再次成为红牛车队顶级的选择，而这似乎是最重要的。小红牛的首要竞技目的，归根结底仍然是作为主队的车手培养学校。
去年仅两场比赛后，红牛就无情地将劳森从高级车队中撤下，他们认为他在两支车队中都没有长期位置。因此，言下之意是他们在考虑是否值得继续留住劳森，而不是用林德布拉德和措洛夫重新构建。
这非常遗憾，因为劳森本赛季显然已经证明自己配得上一个发车格位置。可悲的现实是，如果小红牛是一个独立的竞技实体——它本应如此——他的未来肯定不会成为问题。但如果没有红牛，劳森根本不会在小红牛，林德布拉德也不会在他身边，措洛夫也不会成为选项。不幸的是，你无法将小红牛理想的竞技现实与其所处的复杂大现实分开。
与此相关的是——听起来劳森也可能在为墨西哥的一次愚蠢事件付出代价。他在墨西哥与马克斯·维斯塔潘一方不必要的冲突中没能让自己讨人喜欢，这促使维斯塔潘对劳森不确定的未来发表了评论。你认为谁更应该受到指责并不重要；在巴西令人好奇的是，劳森似乎在暗示这件事改变了什么。
劳森说：“我绝对没想到会有这么大的影响”，并承认，从维修区起步最终获得第七名的喜悦，被他更广泛的处境所冲淡。
“这很难，”他说。“每一天都很难，因为发生的一切。尽管比赛很棒，但我可能还没有完全从那个周末的……或者那个周末发生的事情中恢复过来。”
这一切可能最终对他有利，但这正变得比任何人现实预期的都更像一个故事。措洛夫可能有多好——而且他迟早绝对值得一个机会——但荒谬的是，劳森迄今为止最有力地证明自己应该留任大奖赛车手的这个赛季，却是他完全没有保障的那个赛季。
但是，随着维斯塔潘和伊萨克·哈贾尔锁定红牛车队席位，如果心态是小红牛必须长期为高级车队服务，你可以看到劳森被抛弃的大门是如何打开的——即使他并不该遭此对待。
detailEn: Racing Bulls has re-signed its Formula 1 team leader until 2031 - but that new deal is for team boss Alan Permane, not Liam Lawson, whose future remains “blurry” at best.

Permane, who is ‘co-CEO’ at Racing Bulls, focusing on sporting matters as well as team principal, has signed a long-term contract extension at the team he joined in 2024 after a 34-year career as an increasingly pivotal part of ‘Team Enstone’ through its time as Benetton, Renault and all its myriad identities.

A new Permane deal is deserved. He has overseen enough improvement that the second Red Bull team is on course to secure its best ever result in F1 by finishing fifth in the constructors’ championship. But that is a result to which Lawson, out of contract at the end of the year, has also been pivotal.

And though the contractual situation of a team’s hierarchy is not obliged to play second fiddle to the future of its drivers, it is quite the timing to announce a new deal for the team boss when the F1 world is waiting for a resolution to – and increasingly confused by – Lawson’s situation.
“It's pretty blurry at the moment, honestly,” Lawson said on Thursday in Brazil this week when asked when the team might tell him about his future.
“Not much indication at the moment.”

Racing Bulls – which also means Red Bull, given it pulls the strings where drivers are concerned – is yet to confirm which of Lawson, rookie team-mate Arvid Lindblad, and Formula 2 title contender Nikola Tsolov will race in F1 next year.

Tsolov has been considered next in line for a very long time. Back in September, Permane had indicated a decision would be made “in the coming weeks” and wanted “to take a little bit more time and make sure we get the right pairing for next year”.

Lawson is ninth in the drivers’ championship on 83 points. Subtract the points he and Lindblad scored while Lawson was in a Red Bull for three races mid-season and he is beating the impressive rookie 69-32 in the standings. Lindblad’s one-lap pace has been particularly strong this year, but Lawson has used his experience well, upped his game all-round and been a clear team leader overall.

Unfortunately that is not enough on its own. As Permane said: ”Top of the list is speed and pace and all that goes with that. But there's lots, of course, in the background because we're in a slightly unique situation, I guess.
“We want to bring on young drivers, we want to bring on young talent, and of course we have one eye on them progressing in the future.
“So, it's not just about the here and now, it's also about what they can do in the future.”

Lawson’s ‘here and now’ is very good. But he clearly hasn’t shown enough within the Red Bull family to be a top-level Red Bull Racing option again, which seems to be what matters most of all. Racing Bulls’ primary sporting purpose is still, ultimately, to be a driver finishing school for the main team.

Having dropped Lawson from the senior team ruthlessly after two races last year, Red Bull does not think he has a long-term place at either team. So the implication is they are wondering if it’s worth keeping Lawson around rather than building up anew with Lindblad and Tsolov.

It’s a big shame, as Lawson has evidently proved himself worthy of a place on the grid this season. The sad reality is that if Racing Bulls were its own sporting entity, which it should be, his future would surely be a non-issue – but Lawson wouldn’t be at Racing Bulls in the first place without Red Bull, nor would Lindblad be alongside him, and nor would Tsolov be an option. Unfortunately, you can’t separate the ideal sporting reality of Racing Bulls from the complex wider reality it exists in.

Linked to that – it also sounds like Lawson could be paying the price for a silly incident in Mexico. He did not endear himself to the Max Verstappen side of the Red Bull equation with their needless run-in in Mexico, which prompted Verstappen to make a remark about Lawson’s uncertain future. Whether you think either was more to blame than the other does not really matter; what was curious in Brazil is Lawson seemingly implying it changed something.
Lawson said “I definitely didn't think it'd have such an impact”, and admitted that the joy of finishing seventh after starting from the pitlane was diminished by his wider situation.

“It was hard,” he said. “Every day was just a hard day with everything that was happening. Even though the race was great, I probably hadn't quite got over the weekend’s…or the things that had happened over that weekend.”

It might all work out in his favour, but it’s becoming more of a story than anyone realistically expected it would. As good as Tsolov could be – and he definitely deserves a chance sooner or later – it’s absurd that the season in which Lawson is making by far his most compelling ever case to stay on as a grand prix driver is the one in which he has no security whatsoever.

But with Verstappen and Isack Hadjar locked in at Red Bull Racing, if the mentality is that Racing Bulls must serve the senior team for the longer term, you can see how the door opens to Lawson being jettisoned – even if he doesn’t deserve it.

小红牛本赛季有望以车队积分榜第五名创下队史F1最佳成绩，劳森在其中也发挥了关键作用。
小红牛与红牛尚未确认劳森、新秀队友阿维德·林德布拉德和F2争冠车手尼古拉·措洛夫中谁将在明年出战F1。

items.summaryZh: 2026年第三季度，尽管由于取消的赛事导致收入下降38%，但F1收入已稳定。尽管过去九个月减少了两个赛事，但收入仅减少了200万美元。
items.originalTitle: F1's revenue stabilises after cancelled 2026 grands prix
detailZh: 2026年第三季度，一级方程式赛车（Formula 1）的收入稳定下来，弥补了之前两个季度相对较少赛事带来的损失。
由于赛历调整以及巴林和沙特阿拉伯站的取消，与2025年同期相比，截至2026年6月30日的三个月期间，收入下降了38%。
然而，根据一级方程式赛车母公司Liberty Media在其第三季度收益报告中宣布，F1的收入现在已经稳定。截至9月30日的九个月期间，F1的收入为24.96亿美元，与2025年同期相比仅减少了200万美元，尽管过去九个月减少了两个赛事。
截至2026年9月30日的三个月期间，F1报告的收入同比增长28%，达到11.15亿美元，因为在这段时间内比2025年多举办了一场比赛。F1在截至前九个月的运营收入从2025年的4.33亿美元增加到2026年的4.5亿美元，但调整后的折旧和摊销前的运营收入同比下降5%，至6.49亿美元。
F1首席执行官斯蒂法诺·多梅尼卡利表示，尽管中东地区的冲突使得卡塔尔和阿布扎比大奖赛面临风险，但他预计2026年的赛历将包含23场比赛，比2025年减少一场。
“我很自豪地说，我们再次展示了F1解决挑战的能力，通过在马来西亚成功举办巴林大奖赛，这一赛事取得了巨大的成功，反映了我们商业模式和团队及合作伙伴寻找创造性解决方案以确保我们能够继续比赛的韧性，”多梅尼卡利在第三季度财报电话会议期间表示。
“我还想指出，今年我们在中东地区经历的干扰并没有改变我们的长期区域战略和与我们的推广者的持续合作关系。今年我们目前仍计划在本赛季结束我们的赛历，目前阶段我们继续计划在卡塔尔和阿布扎比结束本赛季。”
由于取消的比赛，锦标赛的主要F1收入有所下降，但赞助收入和酒店收入有所增长。
“这个赛季的每一场比赛都售罄了，其中超过一半打破了观众人数记录，我们的数字印象和观众群体持续增长，”多梅尼卡利表示，他解释说，F1正在探索在上海、银石、奥地利以及“其他几场比赛”中增加Paddock Club贵宾区的容量。
他还补充说：“截至目前，通过奥斯汀，我们已迎来了580万粉丝，并连续18场比赛售罄，其中11场比赛创下了新的观众人数记录。观众人数在增加，我们的社交媒体渠道持续增长，我们调查中粉丝的反馈也异常积极。”
与在拉斯维加斯F1拥有的Grand Prix Plaza举办活动相关的成本降低也有助于F1实现更健康的资产负债表，但国际汽联的收费、货运成本、行政费用（主要由于人员成本增加）以及更高的信息技术成本已经侵蚀了F1的收入。
在过去的三个月里，F1宣布了2027年的赛历，包括10场冲刺赛，2030年代的卢旺达非洲大奖赛，以及2027年2月在米兰的F1 Live活动。
“非洲预计已有超过1亿F1粉丝，其中近60%的关键撒哈拉以南市场的粉丝年龄在35岁以下。因此，这里的长期增长机会是巨大的，”多米尼卡利说。
与Liqui Moly、渣打银行、迪士尼和美泰的合作伙伴关系和授权协议，以及F1的旗舰弹出式商店和枢纽，也在过去一个季度中增强了F1的财务状况。
F1在社交媒体上的追随者数量也有所增长——达到1.29亿，同比增长16%——而总YouTube观看次数现已超过17亿次，同比增长30%，其中比赛亮点占据了217亿次观看，同比增长25%。
detailEn: Formula 1’s revenue has stabilised over the third quarter of 2026 as it made up for the dent caused by a relative lack of races over the previous two quarters.
The calendar shuffle and the cancelled Bahrain and Saudi Arabian rounds led to a 38% drop in revenue over the three-month period until June 30, 2026 compared to the same period in 2025.

However, F1’s revenue has now stabilised, as F1 parent company Liberty Media announced in its third-quarter earnings report. F1’s revenue over the nine months ending September 30 is $2.496 billion USD - a reduction of just $2m compared to the same period in 2025, despite having held two fewer races over the past nine months.

Over the three months ending on September 30, 2026, F1 reported a revenue increase of 28% to $1.115bn year on year as one more race was held during this period compared to 2025. F1’s operating income has increased from $433m in 2025 to $450m in 2026 over the first nine months, but adjusted OIBDA (operating income before depreciation and amortisation) fell 5% to $649m year on year.
F1 CEO Stefano Domenicali said that he expects the 2026 calendar to span 23 races - one fewer than 2025 - despite conflict in the Middle East putting the Qatar and Abu Dhabi Grands Prix at risk.

“I'm proud to say that we again demonstrated F1's ability to solve challenges by successfully staging the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia, and the event was a resounding success, reflecting the resilience of our business model and the incredible ability of our teams and partners to find creative solutions to ensure we can go racing,” said Domenicali during the Q3 earnings call.

“I'd also note that the disruption we experienced in the Middle East this year does not change our long-term regional strategy and ongoing partnership with our promoters. This year we currently remain scheduled to complete our calendar this season and at this stage continue to plan to finish the season in Qatar and Abu Dhabi.”
The championship’s primary F1 revenue decreased due to the cancelled races, but sponsorship revenue and hospitality revenue have grown.

“Every race this season has sold out, with more than half setting attendance records and our digital impressions and audiences continue to grow,” said Domenicali, who explained that F1 is exploring adding Paddock Club hospitality capacity in Shanghai, Silverstone, Austria, and "several other races".

He added: “Season to date through Austin, we have welcomed 5.8 million fans and had 18 consecutive sold-out events, with 11 races setting new attendance records. Audiences are up, our social channels continue to grow, and the feedback from our fans in our surveys has been overwhelmingly positive.”

Lower costs associated with hosting activities at the F1-owned Grand Prix Plaza in Las Vegas have also helped F1 achieve healthier balance sheets, but the FIA’s fees, freight costs, administrative expenses (primarily due to higher personnel costs) and higher information technology costs have chipped away at F1’s income.
Over the past three months, F1 has announced the 2027 calendar with 10 sprints, the African Grand Prix in Rwanda in the 2030s, and the F1 Live event in Milan in February 2027.

“Africa is estimated to be home to more than 100 million Formula 1 fans already, with almost 60% of fans in key sub-Saharan markets under the age of 35. So the long-term growth opportunities here are enormous,” said Domenicali.
Partnership and licensing deals with Liqui Moly, Standard Chartered, Disney, and Mattel, plus F1's flagship pop-up stores and hubs also bolstered F1’s books over the last quarter.

F1 has also seen growth in its social media following - up to 129 million and up 16% year-on-year - while total YouTube views have now surpassed 1.7 billion, up 30% as race highlights comprise 217m of those views, up 25% year on year.
keyPointsZh: 由于取消赛事，2026年6月30日前的三个月收入下降了38%
keyPointsEn: Revenue dropped by 38% in the three months ending June 30, 2026

detailZh: 安东内利：“我的2027年备战从现在开始”——F1夺冠之后
经历旋风般的四天后，安东内利表示他的F1冠军头衔仍感觉不真实、尚未消化，但这并未让他偏离眼前的任务
对安东内利而言，这是相当不平凡的一周。
在墨西哥大奖赛领奖台上庆祝自己创纪录的世界冠军头衔——当时他被汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘高高举起——并参加赛后派对之后，这位意大利车手于周一在墨西哥城被安排参加赞助商活动。
随后，安东内利连夜飞往圣保罗，与塞纳家族进行了一次非常特别的聚会，向他儿时的英雄致敬。在应梅赛德斯冠名赞助商马石油的要求再次出席合作伙伴活动之后，这位F1最年轻的世界冠军重新回到工作中，在英特拉格斯接受了媒体采访。
引用1986年经典电影《春天不是读书天》中主角的话：“生活过得很快。如果你不时不时停下来环顾四周，你可能会错过它。”
对于F1最新的超级明星来说，停下来反思的时刻尚未到来，在残酷的三连赛之中又怎么可能呢？
“这些天我经历了一连串疯狂的事件，”安东内利周四表示。“我赢得了世界冠军，然后与塞纳家族共度时光，这本身已经是不可思议的经历。所以，我当然希望能多一点时间坐下来反思，意识到发生了什么。
“这仍然感觉很不真实，你知道吗？今天早上，车队给了我一件特别的T恤，当我看着它时，我心想：‘哇。这真的吗？’同时发生了太多事情，这让我的脑袋也有点超负荷了。”
观看：基米：改变一切的那两年
以F1世界车手冠军身份结束这一年
安东内利觉得，12月12日在上海举行的国际汽联颁奖典礼将是那个‘清晰的时刻’，届时赛季已经结束，世界冠军奖杯也实实在在地握在他手中，他这一历史性成就终于可以开始真正沉淀下来。
那场庆典将是安东内利正式加冕世界冠军的官方时刻，但F1管理层早已在墨西哥特意捕捉这一瞬间，与梅赛德斯和FIA合作，为安东内利举办了一场量身定制的领奖台仪式。
赛后庆典的制作人选择了标志性的意大利歌曲《今夜无人入睡》，这一巧合恰如其分，因为这是安东内利已故祖父最喜爱的曲调，引发了强烈的情感反应。
随后播放了《Sarà Perché Ti Amo》，呼应了安东内利在蒙扎复出夺冠后这首歌的使用。“第一首歌对我来说非常感人，因为我祖父以前总是听这首歌，所以听到它非常特别，”安东内利在周日晚上赛后说道，泪流满面。“我想他会非常骄傲。”
然而快进到圣保罗，安东内利誓言将剩余的庆祝活动推迟到赛季结束。巴西？一切照常，因为随着冠军头衔的锁定，安东内利已经可以开始思考明年如何卫冕。
“我其实非常兴奋能来到这里，”尽管积攒了疲惫，他说道。“这是一个争取以巅峰状态结束赛季的好机会，但我也觉得我2027年的准备工作从现在开始了。
“以强势表现结束赛季很重要，这样才能在2027年之前积累信心。然后一旦赛季结束，我有几天时间享受其他一切。”
他在2026年的统治地位和提前锁定冠军所带来的奢侈，是无压力地冲击剩余四场比赛的自由。F1会看到一个不同、更具侵略性的安东内利吗？更放松，是的，但安东内利觉得同样重要的是，他不能失去最初让他走到这里、并让他赢得九场大奖赛的那种强度。
“现在冠军已经尘埃落定，我不会那么紧张了，我觉得我能更享受驾驶，”他承认道。“但重要的是不要过于放松。保持同样的强度仍然很重要。当然，我们还有车队冠军要赢，这个周末能锁定它会非常棒。”
“所以，就我而言，我只会想着赢得比赛。我会带着同样的决心和强度、同样的渴望走上赛道。”
“当然，会更放松一些……但也不能太放松。”
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli: “My 2027 preparation starts now” after F1 title triumph
Following four whirlwind days, Kimi Antonelli says his Formula 1 title triumph still feels surreal and unprocessed, but it hasn't distracted him from the task at hand
It has been quite the week for Kimi Antonelli.

After celebrating his record-breaking world title on the Mexico Grand Prix podium, where he was hoisted aloft by Lewis Hamilton and Max Verstappen, and at the post-race party, the Italian was whisked away for sponsor commitments on Monday in the Mexican capital.

Antonelli then flew to Sao Paulo overnight for a very special gathering with the Senna family, paying tribute to his childhood hero. Following another partner appearance at the behest of Mercedes title sponsor Petronas, it was back to business for F1's youngest champion as he addressed the media in Interlagos.
To quote the title character in the classic 1986 film Ferris Bueller's Day Off: "Life moves pretty fast. If you don't stop and look around once in a while, you could miss it."
That time to pause and reflect has not yet arrived for F1's latest superstar, and how could it amid a gruelling triple-header?

"I had such a crazy sequence of events in these days," Antonelli said on Thursday. "I won the championship, then spent time with the Senna family, which was already an incredible event. So, definitely I would have liked a bit more time to just sit down and reflect and realise what happened.

"It still feels surreal, you know? This morning, the team gave me a special t-shirt and when I looked at it, I was like: 'Wow. Is this even real?' There was just so much going on at once that it's kind of overloading my head as well."
Watch: Kimi: Two Years that Changed Everything
Finishing the year as F1 world driver's champion

Antonelli felt the FIA Prize Giving Ceremony on 12 December in Shanghai would be the ‘clear moment’ when his historic achievement could finally begin to sink in, with the season over and the world champion's trophy in his physical possession.

That gala will be the official moment Antonelli is crowned world champion, but F1 management had already gone out of its way to capture the moment in Mexico, working with Mercedes and the FIA to honour Antonelli with a specially tailored podium ceremony.

Producers of the post-race ceremony selected the iconic Italian song Nessun Dorma, a fitting coincidence as it was the favourite tune of Antonelli's late grandfather, triggering a strong emotional reaction.

Sarà Perché Ti Amo then played, echoing its use at Monza following Antonelli’s comeback win. "The first song was very emotional for me because it was a song that my grandfather always used to listen to, so it was very special to hear that," Antonelli said afterwards on Sunday night, reduced to tears. "I think he would be very proud."

Fast-forward to Sao Paulo, though, and Antonelli vowed to put the rest of the celebrations on hold until the season is over. Brazil? Back to business as usual, as with the title secured Antonelli can already start thinking about how to defend it next year.
"I'm actually very excited to be here," he said despite the accumulated fatigue. "It's a good opportunity to try to finish the season on top, but I also feel like my 2027 preparation starts now.
"It's going to be important to finish the season strong in order to gain confidence ahead of 2027. And then once the season is over, I get a few days to enjoy everything else."

The luxury afforded by his 2026 dominance and early title clinch is the freedom to attack the remaining four races without pressure. Will F1 see a different, more aggressive version of Antonelli? More relaxed, yes, but Antonelli felt it was also important for him not to lose the intensity that got him here in the first place and allowed him to win nine grands prix.

"I will not be as tense now that the championship is done, I think I will be able to enjoy the driving even more," he acknowledged. "But the important thing is not to be too relaxed. It's still important to have the same intensity. Of course, we've still got the constructors' championship to win and it will be very nice to clinch it this weekend.
"So, on my side, I will just think about winning the race. I'm going to try to go on track with the same determination and intensity, same hunger.
"Of course, more relaxed... but not too much."

detailZh: 艾伦·珀曼与小红牛F1车队签下新合同
珀曼将留任小红牛车队领队至2031年
红牛已向艾伦·珀曼提供了一份新合同，让他继续担任小红牛一级方程式车队的领队。
珀曼将继续执掌这支位于法恩扎的车队，直至2031赛季结束。
作为当前 阿尔派 车队的中坚力量，他于 1989 年至 2023 年间在该队担任过包括比赛工程师和体育总监在内的多个职务，随后在 2024 赛季前加入 小红牛（当时称为 小红牛）担任赛事总监，并在现任 Laurent Mekies 接替 Christian Horner 前往 红牛 后，被提升为车队领队。
红牛 企业项目与投资首席执行官 Oliver Mintzlaff 表示：“Alan 做得非常出色，车队取得的进步直接反映了他的经验、投入和竞争心态。他带来了清晰、沉着以及对 F1 所需表现的深刻理解，同时营造了一个让人们能够持续发挥最佳水平的环境。
“Visa Cash App 小红牛 近几个赛季取得的成绩凸显了车队的实力以及整个组织所做的工作。Alan 在这一进步中发挥了关键作用，我们非常高兴他将继续领导车队，因为我们期待在未来几年在此基础上再接再厉。
“与担任联合首席执行官（商业）的 Peter Bayer 一起，Alan 组成了一个强大且经验丰富的领导团队。他们彼此互补得极为出色，为组织带来了不同的优势和视角。我很高兴我们拥有了这种稳定性和连续性，为车队的未来发展和长期雄心提供了清晰的平台。”
阿尔维德·林德布拉德，小红牛，艾伦·珀曼，小红牛，利亚姆·劳森，小红牛，彼得·拜尔，小红牛
珀曼补充道：“我非常自豪能与VCARB继续这段旅程，我要感谢红牛所有人给予我的信任和支持。让这支车队与众不同的是每个人共同的精神；无论是在赛道边、在法恩扎还是在米尔顿凯恩斯，每天都能领导这样一群才华横溢且敬业奉献的人是一种荣幸。
“为车队积分榜第五名而战是我们所有人都应该感到非常自豪的事情，但这是许多人多年努力工作的结果，而我们还没有完成。我们拥有合适的人、合适的文化以及明确的前进方向，我很兴奋能继续一起努力。”
这支意大利车队在珀曼的带领下取得了稳步进展，2024年获得46分，去年获得92分，而本赛季迄今已经获得108分，车队几乎确定将锁定车队积分榜第五名——这是自1985年以米纳尔迪之名成立以来的最高排名。
在巴库被问及小红牛车队的进展时，佩尔曼告诉天空体育F1：“我们这一年所做的就是不断给赛车增加负载。我们只是增加下压力，而且每次带来升级，都奏效了。”
detailEn: Alan Permane signs new Racing Bulls F1 deal
Permane will remain Racing Bulls’ team principal until 2031
Red Bull has given Alan Permane a new contract as the Racing Bulls Formula 1 squad’s team principal.
Permane will retain the reins of the Faenza-based outfit until the end of the 2031 season.

A stalwart of the current Alpine squad, where he worked from 1989 to 2023 in various capacities including race engineer and sporting director, Permane joined Racing Bulls (then known as RB) ahead of the 2024 campaign as its racing director, before being promoted to the team principal role when incumbent Laurent Mekies replaced Christian Horner at Red Bull.

Oliver Mintzlaff, CEO Corporate Projects and Investments Red Bull, said: “Alan is doing a tremendous job, and the progress the team has made is a direct reflection of his experience, commitment and competitive mindset. He brings clarity, composure, and a deep understanding of what it takes to perform in Formula 1, while creating an environment where people can consistently deliver at their best.

“The results Visa Cash App Racing Bulls has achieved in recent seasons underline the strength of the team and the work being done throughout the organisation. Alan has played a key role in that progress, and we are very pleased that he will continue to lead the team as we look to build on this momentum in the years ahead.

“Together with Peter Bayer as Co-CEO Commercial, Alan forms a strong and experienced leadership team. They complement each other exceptionally well, bringing different strengths and perspectives to the organisation. I am delighted that we have this stability and continuity in place, providing a clear platform for the team’s future development and long-term ambitions.”
Arvid Lindblad, Racing Bulls, Alan Permane, Racing Bulls, Liam Lawson, Racing Bulls, Peter Bayer, Racing Bulls

Permane added: “I am immensely proud to be continuing this journey with VCARB, and I would like to thank everyone at Red Bull for the trust and support they have given me. What makes this team special is the shared spirit of everyone; trackside, in Faenza and in Milton Keynes, and it is a privilege to lead such a talented and committed group every day.

“Fighting for fifth in the championship is something we should all be very proud of, but it is the result of years of hard work from a lot of people, and we are not done yet. We have the right people, the right culture and a clear sense of where we want to go, and I am excited to keep pushing together.”

The Italian team has made steady progress under Permane, having scored 46 points in 2024, 92 last year and already 108 so far this season, with the outfit all but certain to clinch fifth place in the constructors’ championship – its highest finish ever since it was founded as Minardi in 1985.

Asked about Racing Bulls’ progress back in Baku, Permane told Sky Sports F1: “What we've done through the year is we've just put load on the car. We've just put downforce on, and every time we've brought an upgrade, it's worked.”
